control.description-key: PBS Hub host app Jadwal saya: sessions of a month as a table (Schedule ID, brand, date, account, time, studio, duration, status), KPI cards, the today strip (clock in, absen, kirim report) and filters.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: pageSize (20), absenLeadMin (30), reportDeadlineDays (2), requireAbsen (true).

property.name: Period
property.description-key: Month shown, yyyy-mm. Empty means the current month. The month picker sends PERIOD_CHANGED; canvas reloads the rows and sets this.

property.name: DefaultFilter
property.description-key: Status filter on open: empty, ACTION, PLANNED, FINISHED or CANCELLED.

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the signed-in host [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost. Used for the ABSEN payload.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for this host and month: ID, Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime, JamLive, BrandID, StudioID, HostID, Platform, AccountID, Account, Position, Status.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for this host and month: ID, ClockInDate, CheckInTime, CheckOutTime.

property.name: AbsenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host Absence - PBS Hub] for this host and month: Title, ScheduleID, CheckInTime, Created.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] for this host and month: ID, Title, ScheduleID, LiveDate, ApprovalStatus, ApprovalComment, Created.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when the server has more sessions for the month than were sent: shows Muat lebih banyak (LOAD_MORE).

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: OPEN_SCHEDULE, ABSEN, CLOCK_IN, NEW_REPORT, OPEN_REPORT, PERIOD_CHANGED, FILTER_CHANGED, LOAD_MORE.
